sentences.en: It is the obligation of every worker to pay taxes.
sentences.zh: 每个工人都有纳税的义务。

sentences.en: You are under no obligation whatsoever to share this information.
sentences.zh: 你完全没有分享此信息的责任。

sentences.en: He didn't meet the obligations and was disciplined for that.
sentences.zh: 他没有履行职责因此受到了处罚。

senses.zh: 义务，责任,证券，契约,债务,恩惠
